advanced_security_throughput_mbps.label: Advanced security services throughput
notes: Throughput with advanced security services enabled, including IDS, AMP, and Secure Malware Analytics (formerly Threat Grid), can reach the same levels as with NGFW using Trusted Traffic Exclusions. Learn more .

vpn_tunnels_max.label: Maximum site-to-site VPN tunnels
notes: The maximum number of VPN tunnels is based on lab testing scenarios where no client traffic is transferring over the VPN tunnels. For information on recom­mended maximum site-to-site and client VPN tunnels, visit MX Sizing Principles .
